Triage: lands in `domain:server` (locale negotiation for hook refusal messages) · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:ux (i18n; it had no area) · Bug · on a hosted environment running main, every app hook refusal reaches users whose locale is `zh-Hans` in English, although the app ships its zh-CN pack. `zh-Hans` is not negotiated to the pack, so every refusal message for those business users is untranslated. Reported from a live deployment by its operator (os-bob). A common function wrong for a whole user population is p1 under the 2026-11-21 standard → **p1** · size S.
